notes: One logical two-leg weekly oil/gas relative-flow-divergence package. Q02 evaluates combined package PnL, costs, and density; neither leg is a standalone strategy.

The EA subtracts XNG from XTI separately for the exact prior week's five close-to-open and five open-to-close log returns, trades only strict component disagreement, follows the session-relative sign, targets equal absolute notionals, and caps aggregate frozen-stop risk at one RISK_FIXED budget.
